answer: Let each identity carry a lotus trust score that opens one petal per epoch of verified honest work and collapses to a closed bud on any failed audit. Earnings wait in a harbor escrow and are released as nectar only once the lotus fully blooms, after five clean epochs. An honest agent simply works normally for five epochs at no extra cost. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must sustain 1,000 separate clean histories, 5,000 fake-epochs of real work, before collecting anything, and one failed audit per fake wipes its escrow and restarts its bloom from zero.
